articles.summary: Sonoco and consumer trends agency Caramel have partnered to look ahead to 2027, exploring lifestyle trends that signal where expectations are heading — and uncovering insights that will inspire the future of the packaging market.
articles.title: Lifestyle Trends 2027

articles.summary: The Noirmoutier Sea Salt Cooperative is known for its commitment to responsible production. It has now taken a significant step forward by transitioning its Agri-Éthique labelled range to Sonoco’s GreenCan®, a paper-based packaging solution that supports circularity.
articles.title: From Plastic to Circular Paper-Based Packaging: A New Chapter for Noirmoutier

articles.summary: YourCoffeeTaste is partnering with Sonoco Consumer Packaging EMEA to develop a tailored packaging solution using GreenCan®—bringing full customisation from on-demand coffee roasting—finding the coffee origin that truly fits your taste, combined with fully personalised can printing.
articles.title: YourCoffeeTaste Chooses Sonoco’s GreenCan® for a Fully Personalised Coffee Experience
